description: Canonical structural reference for the current MusashiMap Book I data model. This is not a JSON Schema validator.
integrity_rules: characters lists physical participants in an event; referenced_characters is used for named people involved only through letters, reports, memories or other non-present references.
character-state location is the physically established cartographic position at the end of the section; reported-only positions must use location:null and last_known_location when useful.
location_status values such as reported_position, unknown and departed_* must not be interpreted as physical presence.
character-state destination must not expose a future movement that is first established in a later section.
companions represent physical co-presence in the stated narrative state, not people merely mentioned in dialogue or reports.
appearance/presence without an established origin must not be encoded as a confirmed movement edge.
historical context is separate from novel evidence; external sources may explain a named historical entity but must not be used to invent narrative facts.
historical works are first-class contextual entities and are not modeled as characters or factions.
hinagura and hinagura_stockade are distinct identifiers: the former denotes the broader area and the latter the specific fortified site.
